rootCause: Two native K3s fixture attempts exhausted safe free-space headroom on the 32 GB execution filesystem. The first also used an incorrect kubectl invocation for the extracted fixture binary. The second joining server logged an unresolved numeric-address TLS verification failure. Neither attempt reached three-server enrollment.
resolution: Stopped all new fixtures and preserved databases and evidence. Corrected the fixture kubectl command; losslessly compressed unused binaries with verified round-trip hashes, but storage pressure recurred. Full implementation integration remains blocked pending adequate isolated test capacity and diagnosis of the join TLS failure. No privilege expansion, reset or live-cluster action was used.
